verdict.rationale: 1Password is a password and secrets manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is outside its product role. The pack shows 1Password publishes its own MCP servers (the docs MCP and the Environments MCP Server), but that is the server role. It does not show 1Password consuming other servers' tools, so it does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
